constraints: BB-155 must be DELIVERED before Worker implementation begins; this task extends V2 rather than adding compatibility behavior to legacy Blackboard.
JEV remains an independent judge. A RepairReflection is epistemic state and may authorize a repair attempt, but it cannot assert correctness, readiness, mergeability or delivery.
LOOKBACK is a first-class read-only V2 lifecycle phase, not a hidden boolean inside REPAIRING.

All supervision subjects bind exact workId, workGeneration, Attempt and JevDecision/candidate/evidence identities. Any stale generation or stale attempt/decision binding is SUPERSEDED and cannot advance state.
Decision/reflection publication follows V2 CAS semantics. Mutating side effects require the current Attempt fence; reads/context/nextActions do not.
Material-progress checks happen before another JEV provider dispatch. Control/prose-only changes never count as implementation or evidence progress.
nextActions remains pure/deterministic over the canonical V2 snapshot; supervision cannot introduce controller-local clocks, mutable hidden state or prose-inferred routing.
invariants: Failed candidate judgment never directly grants source-write repair authority; LOOKBACK is a real read-only phase.
Only exact current Work generation/spec/Attempt/failed Decision/candidate/evidence-bound reflection plus live fence and CAS can enter REPAIRING.
Stale/superseded Decision/reflection cannot mutate phase, status or applicable conditions.
Defect requires native tree+implementation projection delta; evidence gap requires trusted material evidence delta; mixed requires both before provider dispatch.

architectureDecisions: D1 — Extend the resolved BB-155 Node/SQLite controller API, never legacy lifecycle. Work.generation is the semantic revision; resourceVersion is CAS. Controller calls ControlStore.apply({workId,action,expectedResourceVersion,expectedGeneration,attemptToken,payload}) and reads readSnapshot/readRecord; trusted pure lifecycle reducer owns phase changes. BB-155 core failed candidate BLOCKED/SUPERVISION_REQUIRED edge is replaced by first-class LOOKBACK. No changes to CAS/clock/fence primitives.

D2 — Validate independent candidate Decision first, with exact current generation/spec/Attempt/fence/candidate/evidence. Apply all-SATISFIED -> MERGE_PENDING; PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION has precedence -> RESEARCHING and invalidates readiness; IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or mixed -> LOOKBACK. PLAN_JUDGMENT remains readiness research routing; this task does not treat failed readiness as candidate repair.

D3 — LOOKBACK gives zero product-source/evidence/spec write authority. It permits read, derive reflection and one guarded PUBLISH_REFLECTION control action. No arbitrary status writes or provider call. Record REPAIR_REFLECTION_V1 is actor epistemic state; it may authorize repair through the store, cannot become independent correctness evidence or mark any answer SATISFIED.

D4 — Reflection binds exact current generation/spec and anchored failed Decision/failedAttempt/candidate/evidence; separately binds current publishingAttempt and live fence/lease. Validate both under one apply CAS; immutable insert+LOOKBACK ->REPAIRING atomic. Stale identity SUPERSEDED/no Work effect, expired authority STALE_FENCE. Operational takeover retains failure facts but revokes old reflection and requires fresh new-owner reflection; lease/id churn never resets material guard.

D5 — Canonical findingSignature=sha256(canonical(sorted([questionId,choice] for non-SATISFIED required answers))). StoreSequence orders APPLIED candidate Decisions within the same Work generation/spec and comparable evaluator question specification. Ignore superseded/readiness/satisfied/incomparable decisions. Compare immediate previous comparable failed candidate Decision: equal signature => STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION; otherwise DIAGNOSIS. Sorting and duplicate question validation prevent order tricks; confidence/probability/text does not affect signature.

D6 — Candidate material progress requires different actual Git tree and different syntax-normalized implementation projection on authorized executable product/test/config paths. The controller uses pinned trusted parser profiles, excludes positions/comments/formatting and non-executable prose/control records, and fails closed on unsupported syntax; no actor-selected normalization. Evidence progress requires different trusted collected set and different typed verified observation/coverage projection. Raw log hashes bind integrity only; run ids/times/durations and formatting never enter material digest. This guard certifies a material change, never correctness.

D7 — Derive guard from immutable failed Decision: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT requires candidate material delta; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE requires evidence material delta; mixed requires both. Compare to failed subject versions, not mutable pointers. Missing objects, invalid provenance or metadata-only churn gives NO_MATERIAL_DELTA. Before provider dispatch, store CAS rechecks subject and material guard and reserves exact current cacheKey once. Identical in-flight/completed subject reuses trusted result/status, never a new paid call. Failed provider transport uses bounded existing transport policy, not a repair judgment loop.

D8 — Reflection contains one exact finding diagnosis with observed evidence refs, old assumption, revised hypothesis, minimal intervention and discriminating verification. Reconsideration additionally explains why prior approach repeated, supplies an alternative strategy and falsification condition; normalized strategy projection must differ from prior accepted reflection. Structural validation cannot certify diagnosis quality. It forces explicit epistemic revision while fresh independent Jev alone determines correctness.

D9 — ContextBuilder consumes pure nextActions output. LOOKBACK includes exact failed Decision/Attempt/subject refs, all failed findings and required mode with empty source writeScope. REPAIRING includes accepted reflection and the existing exact plan scope under current readiness/dependency/lease facts. Immutable reflection is referenced through records, not copied into a second SUPERVISION_STATE or mutable finding summary. nextActions has no I/O/clock/history scan outside supplied canonical snapshot.

D10 — Research binds the final BB-155 plan API now; lack of future product source is not an unresolved design choice. Worker starts only after BB-155 DELIVERED, checks actual exported interface/schema/controller against this declared contract and reopens research if divergent. BB-157 owns supervision module/lifecycle/context/CLI integration only; BB-156 may optionally require its delivered capability for the recommended 155 ->157 ->156 operational order.
implementationSlices: S1 — supervision.mjs: implement strict REPAIR_REFLECTION_V1 validation, findingSignature and deriveReflectionMode with D3-D5/D8; resolve exact immutable failed Decision/Attempt/candidate/evidence refs from store snapshot and reject duplicate/missing diagnoses, authority-verdict fields and stale generation/subject. Export publishRepairReflection wrapper over BB-155 apply PUBLISH_REFLECTION; no direct SQL or duplicate supervision state. Reflection has failedAttemptRef and publishingAttemptRef separately. Validate exact anchored failed subject and current live publisher; stale either cannot grant repair.

S2 — lifecycle.mjs/work-resource.mjs: add LOOKBACK enum and optional exact repairReflectionRef to strict status schema. Implement supervisionContract.dispatchTable with existing trusted candidate validation first: contradiction -> research/revoke; allSAT -> merge; defect/evidence -> LOOKBACK. Read-only LOOKBACK exposes no source/evidence/spec writes or provider request. PUBLISH_REFLECTION performs one CAS/live lease/fence/subject check, immutable insert and phase change to REPAIRING; stale subject SUPERSEDED with zero Work effects. REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT is external JUDGE_CANDIDATE; guard it with exact accepted reflection and materialProgressContract before reservation/dispatch. Keep base SQLite/clock/fence unchanged. Persist optional failureAnchorRef on applied repairable failure. LOOKBACK allows phase-preserving same-owner lease renewal; takeover keeps failed tuple but clears old reflection applicability. Fresh publisher must reflect exact failed subject with new owner ref; material guard still compares the anchored failure, not reset owner/id metadata. N1/N2 test renewal/takeover/new-owner reflection/stale old publisher with zero direct repair/provider dispatch.

S3 — supervision.mjs/lifecycle.mjs/CLI: derive candidate/evidence material projections from trusted object/check facts per D6-D7, compare against immutable failed subject and apply failure-class matrix before dispatch. Wire the pure guard into nextActions and repeat it in store apply/reservation; unchanged/metadata-only subject blocks provider invocation. Unique reservation/cache reuse prevents concurrent repeated calls. No actor hash, reflection text or prose churn unlocks JEV. Implement the pinned parser and typed-evidence profiles in materialProgressContract; lock dependencies in package-lock.json. Add comment/formatting-only candidate and timing-only log variants with zero provider dispatch.

S4 — supervision.mjs/context-builder.mjs: derive signature/mode from immutable snapshot per findingContract, selecting immediate previous comparable APPLIED failure by storeSequence; ignore stale/readiness history. Repeated signature requires reconsideration and normalized strategy projection changed from prior accepted reflection; id/revision/time/format-only churn rejects. Snapshot reader resolves needed records before pure projection. LOOKBACK context shows failed Decision/Attempt/version refs, mode and required output, writeScope=[]; REPAIRING includes exact accepted reflection and existing plan scope only. Store no counter or duplicate finding authority.

S5 — test/blackboard-v2-supervision.test.mjs: invoke actual nextActions, publishRepairReflection, assertMaterialProgress and deriveReflectionMode with all N1-N5 titles. N1 asserts defect/evidence/mixed -> LOOKBACK and context empty scope, contradiction -> research and allSAT -> merge; no direct repair. N4 tests two comparable failures/reordered answers/history yield STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION; producer mode override, revision/whitespace-only strategy cannot satisfy reflection, changed hypothesis+intervention+falsification can. N5 enforces judgeBoundary using separate actor/judge capabilities and actual base trusted validator. Cover every stale exact ref/fence, syntax/log noise, unsupported parser, material positive controls and reservation race; zero dispatch before guards. Run focused/base/repository checks and declared Living state. Worker requires BB-155 DELIVERED and exact updated API; no research model is delivery.

livingDocs.statement: Living system state describes V2 JEV supervision as failed judgment -> read-only LOOKBACK -> exact reflection -> fenced repair -> fresh independent judgment, including material-progress and repeated-finding guards.

supervisionContract.dispatch: Trusted publish candidate Decision uses a single store action transaction. For candidate judgments PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION takes precedence over repairable failures; allSAT iff every required question is present/valid and SATISFIED. Rejected/stale Decision cannot change phase, even if SATISFIED. LOOKBACK is a real enum/table phase and never a boolean in REPAIRING.
supervisionContract.reflectionSchema: {kind:REPAIR_REFLECTION_V1,id,workId,workGeneration,specHash,failedAttemptRef:{id,hash},publishingAttemptRef:{id,hash},failedDecisionRef:{id,hash},candidate:{sha,tree,versionRef,implementationDigest},evidence:{setRef,setHash,materialDigest},findingSignature,mode:DIAGNOSIS|STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION,diagnoses:[{questionId,choice,observedRefs,oldAssumption,revisedHypothesis,minimalIntervention,verificationIds,expectedCounterexample}],strategy:{revision,approach,alternatives?,whyPreviousRepeated?,falsificationCondition?}}. No correctness/ready/accepted/delivery verdict field. Strict known keys; nonempty diagnosis per failed question exactly once; required refs resolve to immutable failed subject or declared plan.
supervisionContract.publication: PUBLISH_REFLECTION resolves current failureAnchor and its exact immutable failed Attempt/Decision/candidate/evidence; independently resolves publishingAttemptRef/current live lease/fence from status. Both exact refs plus current Work generation/spec and derived mode/strategy are checked in one apply CAS; accepted record+LOOKBACK ->REPAIRING atomic. Malformed authority rejects; stale failure/generation/owner/reflection is SUPERSEDED with zero Work effects; expired fence/lease rejects STALE_FENCE. Same id/body retry only idempotent result, never new authority.
supervisionContract.ownership: FailureAnchor names the latest APPLIED failed candidate tuple for current Work generation/spec. Attempt ownership and failed-subject identity are separate: reflection binds failedAttemptRef exactly to the anchored failed Decision, and publishingAttemptRef exactly to current live owner/fence. Renew changes only LeaseVersion. LOOKBACK takeover uses base CAS/store clock to create new owner Attempt/fence, retains immutable failureAnchor, clears old reflection applicability and still grants no source writes. New owner must publish a fresh reflection with both exact refs before repair. A late old-owner Decision publication is SUPERSEDED; the already APPLIED failure remains diagnostic baseline until actual new judgment or semantic revision. No owner/id/lease churn unlocks material retry.
supervisionContract.readOnly: LOOKBACK product/evidence/spec writeScope=[]; read/derive reflection plus same-owner typed RENEW_LEASE for operational ownership only. Sole semantic publication is PUBLISH_REFLECTION; store owns phase transition. No candidate/evidence/spec publication or JEV dispatch.
supervisionContract.baseAPI: BB-155 readSnapshot/createWork/apply/readRecord; Work id/resourceVersion/generation/spec/status. Immutable Attempt identity, LeaseVersion and candidate/evidence version records; status activeAttemptRef/activeLeaseRef/candidateVersionRef/evidenceVersionRef/latestCandidateDecisionRef. nextActions/reduceLifecycle/buildContext, materializeWorkJudgment and existing independent evaluate/validateEvaluation. BB-157 adds optional status.repairReflectionRef (immutable exact ref) and LOOKBACK to the strict V2 schema; it changes no SQLite CAS/clock/fence primitive. readSnapshot returns {work,records,systemFacts}; binding checks read snapshot.work, not a flattened envelope. Add status.failureAnchorRef as optional exact failed Decision ref; clear on semantic revision, contradiction or allSAT. Keep it over LOOKBACK takeover, with reflection applicability revoked.
dispatchTable: Independent PUBLISH_DECISION(kind=candidate) first passes existing typed evaluation validation plus exact current Work-generation/spec/Attempt/candidate/evidence and live lease/fence/CAS. Missing answer, forged identity or wrong phase rejects; stale trusted subject is SUPERSEDED without Work changes.

Any required PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION -> RESEARCHING and revoke readiness/current subject ownership. Otherwise every required SATISFIED -> MERGE_PENDING. Otherwise IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT and/or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE -> LOOKBACK, preserve exact failed subject refs and current owner. No direct REPAIRING or source write.

LOOKBACK exposes READ_FAILURE/DERIVE_REFLECTION with product/evidence/spec writeScope=[] and JEV forbidden. Phase-preserving RENEW_LEASE and expired-lease TAKEOVER maintain ownership only. PUBLISH_REFLECTION alone changes semantic phase, after exact failure/current publisher/mode/strategy/fence checks; record append and REPAIRING transition are atomic and cannot accept correctness.

REPAIRING stages immutable candidate/evidence versions using base store. External JUDGE_CANDIDATE maps to base REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT: accepted current reflection, exact current readiness/dependencies/lease, required material deltas and unique subject reservation must all pass under CAS before JUDGING/dispatch. Failure emits blockers and zero provider calls. A fresh failed Decision returns LOOKBACK; a fresh independent allSAT alone advances MERGE_PENDING.

materialProgressContract.candidateProjection: Resolve immutable candidate Git objects and authorized plan product/test/config paths; sort {path,mode,profile,syntaxDigest}. Controller-owned normalizer profiles: JS/MJS via acorn 8.15.0 parse(ecmaVersion:latest,sourceType:module), strip start/end/loc/range/comment and ordinary literal raw but preserve value, directive, regex source/flags, template raw/cooked and hashbang where execution-sensitive; JSON parsed value with duplicate-key rejection; YAML 2.8.1 parsed trusted document semantics with duplicate keys/unknown custom tags rejected. Retain executable directives/comments if a declared tool consumes them; such profiles must be declared before judgment. Unsupported language/ambiguous parse has no approved projection and blocks dispatch until research resolves a trusted profile, never fallback to raw blob hash. Different native tree and syntax projection required. Whitespace/comment-only JS, prose/control record edits or same-tree commits fail NO_MATERIAL_DELTA. Exclude authority artifact bodies, not source implementing the controller. AST difference does not imply behavioral correctness; independent JEV decides.
materialProgressContract.evidenceProjection: Collector retains raw stdout/stderr hashes, full log bytes and command/candidate bindings for integrity. Material digest uses sorted {verificationId,commandHash,candidateTree,exitCode,typedObservations,criterionCoverage,negativeCaseBindingsHash,collectorProfileVersion}. typedObservations are trusted parser-extracted assertion/test ids, pass/fail/skipped outcomes, declared numeric result values and criterion observations; omit timestamps/durations/run ids/paths/formatting/raw stream hashes. Node-test TAP/spec profiles derive identical facts for identical outcomes despite changing timing or order; deduplicate and sort fact ids, reject ambiguity/incomplete/truncated/unverified logs. Opaque logs require a research-approved pinned parser profile before they can prove evidence delta; no actor chosen fields or arbitrary text-as-material fallback. Both exact setHash and materialDigest must change. More genuine verified coverage/observations may pass; another run with the same facts cannot. Jev still sees bound full evidence, including raw hashes.
materialProgressContract.guardSignature: assertMaterialProgress(failedDecision,currentSubject,{candidateProjection,evidenceProjection}) -> {eligible,requiredDeltas,blockers}; pure over validated facts. Type-specific required deltas from failed answers. Missing failed/current fields fails closed. It neither calls provider nor alters status. Lifecycle repeats guard before entering actionable JUDGING, server repeats within dispatch reservation transaction.
materialProgressContract.reservation: unique {workId,workGeneration,attemptId,candidateTree,evidenceSetHash,questionSpecHash,model,policy,cacheKey}; provider call happens only after successful reservation+exact action guard. Concurrent controllers dispatch at most once; reuse in-flight or completed record. A failed independent judgment returns LOOKBACK again. No generation bump or record-name churn evades material comparison.

parserPins.resolution: Registry version/integrity inspected during research; Worker pins exact lockfile and trusted normalization profiles. No dependencies installed or production normalizers delivered by research.

findingContract.signature: sha256(canonical sorted [questionId,typedChoice] for all required non-SATISFIED candidate answers). Unique IDs and valid response coverage required beforehand; confidence/producer text excluded.
findingContract.previous: Highest storeSequence less than current in supplied immutable Decisions with same workId/generation/specHash, APPLIED candidate kind, nonSatisfied and comparable questionSpecHash. Store sequence is authoritative. Superseded/readiness results do not increment a hidden count or reset a repeated finding.
findingContract.mode: First/changed finding DIAGNOSIS; identical prior signature STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION. Current status stores only exact reflection ref and Decision ref; mode/signature are deterministically recomputed and checked, never a separate authoritative repeatCount/finding-summary resource.
findingContract.authority: Reflection validates coverage/binding/required epistemic fields; it does not choose SATISFIED. Candidate material + evidence + a new independently validated JevDecision are still required for MERGE_PENDING. FailureAnchor is a ref to the already immutable Decision, not a duplicate failure summary. Reflection/lease maintenance cannot alter its failed answers.
findingContract.strategy: For a repeated comparable finding, resolve the previous accepted reflection by exact previous failed Decision ref from immutable records. Require whyPreviousRepeated, an alternative approach and a falsification condition. Strategy digest excludes revision/id/time/reflection prose outside {diagnoses.questionId/revisedHypothesis/minimalIntervention/verificationIds/expectedCounterexample,strategy.approach/alternatives/falsificationCondition}; NFKC+trim+whitespace-fold strings, sort question/verification IDs. Digest must differ from prior accepted strategy; bumping revision or reformatting cannot pass. It enforces explicit epistemic revision, not correctness; independent Jev judges the subsequent candidate.
findingContract.snapshot: readSnapshot supplies exact current Decision plus immutable comparable candidate Decisions and accepted reflections needed for predecessor selection, ordered by storeSequence. deriveReflectionMode filters same Work generation/spec/questionSpecHash, APPLIED non-satisfied candidate results and selects max prior sequence. It recomputes canonical signature/mode from these facts, independent of producer mode or mutable counter. nextActions/buildContext read this supplied snapshot only; the SQL reader assembles it before pure projection.

dependencyContract.implementationPrecondition: DELIVERED plus actual exports/schema/controller match resolved contract above; no legacy substitution
dependencyContract.researchBasis: The exact selected base interfaces are resolved plan-owned inputs. The materialized research state includes this complete contract; future source existence is not claimed.

researchSummary.limits: Model confirms feasibility/control invariants. It omits production full auth/schema, trusted material normalization and provider reservation; required future product tests target these directly. No real independent SATISFIED result is inferred.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: A failed candidate JevDecision with IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT and/or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE transitions JUDGING to read-only LOOKBACK rather than directly granting REPAIRING/source-write authority.
A valid RepairReflection binds the current workGeneration, failed JevDecision, Attempt, candidate and evidence and is the only semantic input that can authorize LOOKBACK -> REPAIRING.
A stale/superseded JevDecision or RepairReflection cannot change Work status, phase or conditions.

Before JUDGE_CANDIDATE can become actionable again, IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT requires candidate-tree delta, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE requires evidence delta, and mixed failures require both relevant deltas.

Repeated identical non-satisfied finding signatures select STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION rather than ordinary DIAGNOSIS; the rule is derived from immutable Decisions and does not require duplicate authoritative supervision state.
JEV remains the final independent judge after repair; RepairReflection text or metadata cannot satisfy the failed finding by itself.

researchReproduction.extract: Decode each gzipBase64 into named files under an owned scratch directory. Set V2_RESEARCH_SOURCE_ROOT to a Git repository containing exact d795bca0e1865685d6b11b66de12224691446897 objects; execute node --test probe.test.mjs. Legacy graph and routing source are read with git show at that immutable SHA, not from current checkout. All service databases/config/Git worktrees are owned scratch and disposed.

judgeBoundary.authority: PUBLISH_REFLECTION has actor capability and cannot publish a Decision. Strict reflection schema rejects answers/verdict/accepted/delivery/ready fields. Only judge capability plus existing validateEvaluation against freshly materialized exact subject can publish candidate correctness.
judgeBoundary.evidence: materializeWorkJudgment uses original objective/READY plan, current immutable candidate and trusted collected criterion/negative-case evidence. Reflection text, mode, strategy revision and metadata are not correctness evidence, do not change questionSpecHash/cacheKey and cannot satisfy a failed finding. Context may show reflection for repair reasoning; criterion judgment remains independent.
judgeBoundary.test: N5 calls actual publishRepairReflection/apply then observes REPAIRING (never MERGE_PENDING), unchanged failed answers and zero provider calls. Attempt actor-published allSAT/missing answers must reject; only a separate trusted judge fixture satisfying exact new subject reaches MERGE_PENDING after material guards. Fixtures are test data, never real SATISFIED receipt.

lookbackBlueprint.transition: Actual apply(PUBLISH_DECISION,candidate) validates the independent full typed evaluation and exact Work-generation/spec/current Attempt/candidate/evidence first. If any PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION, research/revoke; else allSAT, merge; else defects/evidence/mixed set phase LOOKBACK and failureAnchorRef to this immutable APPLIED Decision in one CAS. Preserve failed inputs, append no repaired candidate/evidence and grant no source scope.
lookbackBlueprint.permissions: For LOOKBACK, actual nextActions/buildContext grant product/evidence/spec writeScope=[]; no PUBLISH_CANDIDATE, PUBLISH_EVIDENCE or JUDGE_CANDIDATE action. Same-owner RENEW_LEASE only maintains operational ownership and leaves phase/failure/semantics unchanged. Only PUBLISH_REFLECTION can semantically enter REPAIRING after all exact binding/fence/CAS checks; reflection never accepts correctness.
lookbackBlueprint.fixture: N1 uses actual exported store/lifecycle/context and independent trusted fixture for each defect,evidence,mixed,contradiction,allSAT case. For repairable failures assert persisted phase LOOKBACK; latest Decision/failureAnchor exact; context scope empty; provider counter0; failed tuple unchanged. Invoke actual candidate/evidence/judgment actions with a valid live owner token: each must reject PHASE_FORBIDDEN and leave Work/records/files/provider count unchanged. Publish valid exact reflection then assert REPAIRING only. No narrative or future log existence is counted as passed product verification.
